account_balance_bounds_check.name: account_balance_bounds_check
account_balance_bounds_check.value: ("account_balance"."min_balance_minor" IS NULL OR "account_balance"."balance_minor" >= "account_balance"."min_balance_minor") AND ("account_balance"."max_balance_minor" IS NULL OR "account_balance"."balance_minor" <= "account_balance"."max_balance_minor")

calendar_event_link_from_shape_check.name: calendar_event_link_from_shape_check
calendar_event_link_from_shape_check.value:
("calendar_event_link"."from_matter_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "calendar_event_link"."from_firm_event_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("calendar_event_link"."from_matter_event_id" IS NULL AND "calendar_event_link"."from_firm_event_id" IS NOT NULL)

calendar_event_link_to_shape_check.name: calendar_event_link_to_shape_check
calendar_event_link_to_shape_check.value:
("calendar_event_link"."to_matter_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "calendar_event_link"."to_firm_event_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("calendar_event_link"."to_matter_event_id" IS NULL AND "calendar_event_link"."to_firm_event_id" IS NOT NULL)

calendar_event_link_continuance_matter_c.name: calendar_event_link_continuance_matter_check
calendar_event_link_continuance_matter_c.value: "calendar_event_link"."kind" <> 'continuance_of' OR ("calendar_event_link"."from_matter_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "calendar_event_link"."to_matter_event_id" IS NOT NULL)

communication_producer_shape_check.name: communication_producer_shape_check
communication_producer_shape_check.value:
("communication"."producer" = 'member') = ("communication"."logged_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("communication"."producer" = 'carrier' OR "communication"."carrier_reference" IS NULL)

custody_destruction_request_approver_che.name: custody_destruction_request_approver_check
custody_destruction_request_approver_che.value: "custody_destruction_request"."approved_by" IS NULL OR "custody_destruction_request"."requested_by" IS NULL OR "custody_destruction_request"."approved_by" <> "custody_destruction_request"."requested_by"

custody_movement_borrower_shape_check.name: custody_movement_borrower_shape_check
custody_movement_borrower_shape_check.value: ("custody_movement"."borrower_kind" IS NULL) OR ("custody_movement"."borrower_kind" = 'member' AND "custody_movement"."borrower_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("custody_movement"."borrower_kind" = 'entity' AND "custody_movement"."borrower_entity_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("custody_movement"."borrower_kind" = 'external' AND "custody_movement"."borrower_name" IS NOT NULL)

custody_stocktake_closure_check.name: custody_stocktake_closure_check
custody_stocktake_closure_check.value: ("custody_stocktake"."status" = 'open' AND "custody_stocktake"."closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("custody_stocktake"."status" <> 'open' AND "custody_stocktake"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)

custody_stocktake_sighting_shape_check.name: custody_stocktake_sighting_shape_check
custody_stocktake_sighting_shape_check.value: ("custody_stocktake_sighting"."kind" = 'sighted' AND "custody_stocktake_sighting"."packet_id" IS NOT NULL AND "custody_stocktake_sighting"."location_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("custody_stocktake_sighting"."kind" = 'not_found' AND "custody_stocktake_sighting"."packet_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("custody_stocktake_sighting"."kind" = 'unregistered' AND "custody_stocktake_sighting"."packet_id" IS NULL AND "custody_stocktake_sighting"."item_id" IS NULL AND "custody_stocktake_sighting"."location_id" IS NOT NULL AND "custody_stocktake_sighting"."description" IS NOT NULL AND length("custody_stocktake_sighting"."description") > 0)

directory_person_pronoun_complete_check.name: directory_person_pronoun_complete_check
directory_person_pronoun_complete_check.value:
("directory_person"."pronoun_object" IS NULL) = ("directory_person"."pronoun_subject" IS NULL)
        AND ("directory_person"."pronoun_possessive_determiner" IS NULL) = ("directory_person"."pronoun_subject" IS NULL)
        AND ("directory_person"."pronoun_possessive_pronoun" IS NULL) = ("directory_person"."pronoun_subject" IS NULL)
        AND ("directory_person"."pronoun_reflexive" IS NULL) = ("directory_person"."pronoun_subject" IS NULL)
        AND ("directory_person"."pronoun_verb_number" IS NULL) = ("directory_person"."pronoun_subject" IS NULL)

firm_event_end_time_check.name: firm_event_end_time_check
firm_event_end_time_check.value: "firm_event"."ends_at_time" IS NULL OR "firm_event"."starts_at_time" IS NOT NULL

firm_event_participant_shape_check.name: firm_event_participant_shape_check
firm_event_participant_shape_check.value:
("firm_event_participant"."participant_kind" = 'member' AND "firm_event_participant"."member_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("firm_event_participant"."participant_kind" = 'entity' AND "firm_event_participant"."entity_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("firm_event_participant"."participant_kind" = 'external' AND "firm_event_participant"."participant_name" IS NOT NULL)

firm_resource_booking_event_shape_check.name: firm_resource_booking_event_shape_check
firm_resource_booking_event_shape_check.value:
("firm_resource_booking"."matter_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "firm_resource_booking"."firm_event_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("firm_resource_booking"."matter_event_id" IS NULL AND "firm_resource_booking"."firm_event_id" IS NOT NULL)

firm_resource_booking_end_time_check.name: firm_resource_booking_end_time_check
firm_resource_booking_end_time_check.value: "firm_resource_booking"."ends_at_time" IS NULL OR "firm_resource_booking"."starts_at_time" IS NOT NULL

index_split_document_version_unique.name: index_split_document_version_unique
index_split_document_version_unique.where: "index_split"."document_id" IS NOT NULL AND "index_split"."superseded_at" IS NULL

invoice_number_draw_paired_check.name: invoice_number_draw_paired_check
invoice_number_draw_paired_check.value: ("invoice"."invoice_number" IS NULL) = ("invoice"."number_drawn_value" IS NULL) AND ("invoice"."invoice_number" IS NULL) = ("invoice"."number_scope_key" IS NULL)

invoice_dates_final_check.name: invoice_dates_final_check
invoice_dates_final_check.value: "invoice"."status" <> 'final' OR ("invoice"."issue_date" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice"."due_date" IS NOT NULL)

matter_asset_identifier_presence_check.name: matter_asset_identifier_presence_check
matter_asset_identifier_presence_check.value: "matter_asset_identifier"."display_suffix" IS NOT NULL OR "matter_asset_identifier"."value_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL

matter_billing_arrangement_kind_shape_ch.name: matter_billing_arrangement_kind_shape_check
matter_billing_arrangement_kind_shape_ch.value:
("matter_billing_arrangement"."kind" = 'flat_fee') = ("matter_billing_arrangement"."flat_fee_amount_minor" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("matter_billing_arrangement"."kind" = 'contingency') = ("matter_billing_arrangement"."contingency_share_e4" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("matter_billing_arrangement"."kind" = 'contingency') = ("matter_billing_arrangement"."contingency_basis" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("matter_billing_arrangement"."kind" = 'retainer') = ("matter_billing_arrangement"."retainer_target_minor" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("matter_billing_arrangement"."kind" = 'retainer') = ("matter_billing_arrangement"."retainer_threshold_minor" IS NOT NULL)

matter_deadline_catalog_shape_check.name: matter_deadline_catalog_shape_check
matter_deadline_catalog_shape_check.value:
("matter_deadline"."source" = 'statutory_catalog' AND "matter_deadline"."catalog_entry_key" IS NOT NULL AND "matter_deadline"."catalog_version" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("matter_deadline"."source" <> 'statutory_catalog' AND "matter_deadline"."catalog_entry_key" IS NULL AND "matter_deadline"."catalog_version" IS NULL)

matter_deadline_state_reason_check.name: matter_deadline_state_reason_check
matter_deadline_state_reason_check.value: "matter_deadline"."state" NOT IN ('vacated', 'superseded') OR ("matter_deadline"."state_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length("matter_deadline"."state_reason") > 0)

matter_deadline_satisfaction_shape_check.name: matter_deadline_satisfaction_shape_check
matter_deadline_satisfaction_shape_check.value:
("matter_deadline"."state" = 'satisfied' AND "matter_deadline"."satisfied_at" IS NOT NULL AND "matter_deadline"."satisfied_by" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("matter_deadline"."state" <> 'satisfied' AND "matter_deadline"."satisfied_at" IS NULL AND "matter_deadline"."satisfied_by" IS NULL)

matter_event_end_time_check.name: matter_event_end_time_check
matter_event_end_time_check.value: "matter_event"."ends_at_time" IS NULL OR "matter_event"."starts_at_time" IS NOT NULL

matter_event_participant_shape_check.name: matter_event_participant_shape_check
matter_event_participant_shape_check.value:
("matter_event_participant"."participant_kind" = 'member' AND "matter_event_participant"."member_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("matter_event_participant"."participant_kind" = 'entity' AND "matter_event_participant"."entity_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("matter_event_participant"."participant_kind" = 'external' AND "matter_event_participant"."participant_name" IS NOT NULL)

matter_note_occurrence_shape_check.name: matter_note_occurrence_shape_check
matter_note_occurrence_shape_check.value:
("matter_note"."occurred_at_time" IS NULL OR "matter_note"."occurred_on" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("matter_note"."occurred_at_time" IS NULL) = ("matter_note"."time_zone" IS NULL)

matter_plan_task_template_offset_shape_c.name: matter_plan_task_template_offset_shape_check
matter_plan_task_template_offset_shape_c.value:
("matter_plan_task_template"."due_anchor" = 'none' AND "matter_plan_task_template"."offset_days" IS NULL)
        OR ("matter_plan_task_template"."due_anchor" != 'none' AND "matter_plan_task_template"."offset_days" IS NOT NULL)

matter_task_archive_shape_check.name: matter_task_archive_shape_check
matter_task_archive_shape_check.value:
("matter_task"."archived_at" IS NULL) = ("matter_task"."archived_by" IS NULL)
        AND ("matter_task"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL OR "matter_task"."archive_reason" IS NULL)

matter_task_due_shape_check.name: matter_task_due_shape_check
matter_task_due_shape_check.value:
("matter_task"."due_at_time" IS NULL OR "matter_task"."due_on" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("matter_task"."due_on" IS NULL) = ("matter_task"."time_zone" IS NULL)

matter_task_completion_shape_check.name: matter_task_completion_shape_check
matter_task_completion_shape_check.value:
("matter_task"."state" = 'done' AND "matter_task"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "matter_task"."completed_by" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("matter_task"."state" != 'done' AND "matter_task"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "matter_task"."completed_by" IS NULL)

matter_task_cancellation_shape_check.name: matter_task_cancellation_shape_check
matter_task_cancellation_shape_check.value:
("matter_task"."state" = 'cancelled' AND "matter_task"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "matter_task"."cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "matter_task"."cancellation_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length("matter_task"."cancellation_reason") > 0)
        OR ("matter_task"."state" != 'cancelled' AND "matter_task"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "matter_task"."cancelled_by" IS NULL
          AND "matter_task"."cancellation_reason" IS NULL)

meeting_event_shape_check.name: meeting_event_shape_check
meeting_event_shape_check.value:
("meeting"."event_kind" = 'matter' AND "meeting"."matter_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "meeting"."firm_event_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("meeting"."event_kind" = 'firm' AND "meeting"."firm_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "meeting"."matter_event_id" IS NULL)

meeting_ended_shape_check.name: meeting_ended_shape_check
meeting_ended_shape_check.value:
("meeting"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "meeting"."ended_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("meeting"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "meeting"."ended_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

review_document_exactly_one_source_check.name: review_document_exactly_one_source_check
review_document_exactly_one_source_check.value: ("review_document"."file_version_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("review_document"."email_message_id" IS NOT NULL) = 1

trust_authorization_policy_threshold_sha.name: trust_authorization_policy_threshold_shape_check
trust_authorization_policy_threshold_sha.value: ("trust_authorization_policy"."policy" = 'threshold' AND "trust_authorization_policy"."threshold_amount_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_authorization_policy"."threshold_amount_minor" >= 0) OR ("trust_authorization_policy"."policy" <> 'threshold' AND "trust_authorization_policy"."threshold_amount_minor" IS NULL)

trust_disbursement_decision_shape_check.name: trust_disbursement_decision_shape_check
trust_disbursement_decision_shape_check.value:
("trust_disbursement_decision"."decision" = 'approved' AND "trust_disbursement_decision"."authorization_basis" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_disbursement_decision"."reason" IS NULL AND (("trust_disbursement_decision"."movement_id" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_disbursement_decision"."transfer_id" IS NULL) OR ("trust_disbursement_decision"."transfer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_disbursement_decision"."movement_id" IS NULL)))
        OR ("trust_disbursement_decision"."decision" = 'rejected' AND "trust_disbursement_decision"."authorization_basis" IS NULL AND "trust_disbursement_decision"."movement_id" IS NULL AND "trust_disbursement_decision"."transfer_id" IS NULL AND length("trust_disbursement_decision"."reason") > 0)
        OR ("trust_disbursement_decision"."decision" = 'withdrawn' AND "trust_disbursement_decision"."authorization_basis" IS NULL AND "trust_disbursement_decision"."movement_id" IS NULL AND "trust_disbursement_decision"."transfer_id" IS NULL AND ("trust_disbursement_decision"."reason" IS NULL OR length("trust_disbursement_decision"."reason") > 0))

trust_ledger_node_shape_check.name: trust_ledger_node_shape_check
trust_ledger_node_shape_check.value:
("trust_ledger_node"."kind" = 'client' AND "trust_ledger_node"."client_entity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_ledger_node"."matter_id" IS NULL AND "trust_ledger_node"."parent_node_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("trust_ledger_node"."kind" = 'matter' AND "trust_ledger_node"."client_entity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_ledger_node"."matter_id" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_ledger_node"."parent_node_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("trust_ledger_node"."kind" = 'firm_funds' AND "trust_ledger_node"."client_entity_id" IS NULL AND "trust_ledger_node"."matter_id" IS NULL AND "trust_ledger_node"."parent_node_id" IS NULL)

trust_movement_shape_check.name: trust_movement_shape_check
trust_movement_shape_check.value:
("trust_movement"."kind" = 'deposit' AND "trust_movement"."counterparty_node_id" IS NULL AND "trust_movement"."method" <> 'internal' AND "trust_movement"."counterparty_name" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("trust_movement"."kind" = 'disbursement' AND "trust_movement"."counterparty_node_id" IS NULL AND "trust_movement"."method" <> 'internal' AND "trust_movement"."counterparty_name" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_movement"."authorized_by" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("trust_movement"."kind" = 'matter_transfer' AND "trust_movement"."counterparty_node_id" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_movement"."counterparty_node_id" <> "trust_movement"."node_id" AND "trust_movement"."method" = 'internal' AND "trust_movement"."counterparty_name" IS NULL AND "trust_movement"."authorized_by" IS NOT NULL)

trust_reconciliation_shape_check.name: trust_reconciliation_shape_check
trust_reconciliation_shape_check.value:
("trust_reconciliation"."status" = 'open' AND "trust_reconciliation"."closed_by" IS NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_statement_closing_minor" IS NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_outstanding_deposits_minor" IS NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_outstanding_disbursements_minor" IS NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_adjusted_bank_minor" IS NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_book_balance_minor" IS NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_client_total_minor" IS NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_unmatched_line_count" IS NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_unmatched_movement_count" IS NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_balanced" IS NULL)
        OR ("trust_reconciliation"."status" = 'closed' AND "trust_reconciliation"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_statement_closing_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_outstanding_deposits_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_outstanding_disbursements_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_adjusted_bank_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_book_balance_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_client_total_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_unmatched_line_count" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_unmatched_movement_count" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_balanced" IN (0, 1))

trust_reconciliation_outstanding_sign_ch.name: trust_reconciliation_outstanding_sign_check
trust_reconciliation_outstanding_sign_ch.value:
("trust_reconciliation"."frozen_outstanding_deposits_minor" IS NULL OR "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_outstanding_deposits_minor" >= 0)
        AND ("trust_reconciliation"."frozen_outstanding_disbursements_minor" IS NULL OR "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_outstanding_disbursements_minor" >= 0)
        AND ("trust_reconciliation"."frozen_unmatched_line_count" IS NULL OR "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_unmatched_line_count" >= 0)
        AND ("trust_reconciliation"."frozen_unmatched_movement_count" IS NULL OR "trust_reconciliation"."frozen_unmatched_movement_count" >= 0)

trust_unclaimed_funds_contact_attempt_sh.name: trust_unclaimed_funds_contact_attempt_shape_check
trust_unclaimed_funds_contact_attempt_sh.value:
("trust_unclaimed_funds_contact_attempt"."channel" = 'record_review' AND "trust_unclaimed_funds_contact_attempt"."contact_used" IS NULL)
        OR ("trust_unclaimed_funds_contact_attempt"."channel" <> 'record_review' AND "trust_unclaimed_funds_contact_attempt"."contact_used" IS NOT NULL AND length("trust_unclaimed_funds_contact_attempt"."contact_used") > 0)

trust_unclaimed_funds_review_closure_sha.name: trust_unclaimed_funds_review_closure_shape_check
trust_unclaimed_funds_review_closure_sha.value:
("trust_unclaimed_funds_review_closure"."outcome" = 'distributed_to_owner' AND "trust_unclaimed_funds_review_closure"."movement_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("trust_unclaimed_funds_review_closure"."outcome" <> 'distributed_to_owner' AND "trust_unclaimed_funds_review_closure"."movement_id" IS NULL)
